description: This file declares the API for managing QoS flow statistics on a MoCA interface, including getter methods for various flow parameters such as FlowID, packet destination address, MaxRate, MaxBurstSize, LeaseTime, LeaseTimeLeft, and FlowPackets, intended for use in TR-069 based remote management.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats
classes.description: Class providing getter methods for QoS FlowStats parameters related to a MoCA interface.

methods.name: get_FlowID
methods.description: Retrieves the FlowID used to identify a flow in the network, based on the mocaIfFlowID from MOCA11-MIB.

methods.name: get_PacketDA
methods.description: Retrieves the Destination Address for packets in this flow.

methods.name: get_MaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum required rate in Kbps for the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxBurstSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum burst size for the flow.

methods.name: get_LeaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the flow lease time in seconds; 0 indicates unlimited.

methods.name: get_LeaseTimeLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining lease time for the flow in seconds.

methods.name: get_FlowPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets transmitted for this flow.
